title: HATEOAS API
description: Build a HATEOAS-compliant API where responses include hypermedia links for resource discovery and navigation.

steps.title: Root endpoint with links
steps.description: Create a GET / endpoint that returns a JSON object with a "links" array containing rel and href for available resources.
hints: Return an object with a links array
Each link has: rel (relationship) and href (URL)
Include links to users and posts resources

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class Link(BaseModel):
    rel: str
    href: str

class RootResponse(BaseModel):
    links: list[Link]

@app.get('/')
def root():
    return RootResponse(links=[
        Link(rel='self', href='/'),
        Link(rel='users', href='/users'),
        Link(rel='posts', href='/posts')
    ])

steps.title: Resource with self link
steps.description: Create GET /users/:id that returns a user object with a "links" array containing a self link.
hints: Each user response includes both data and a links array
The self link points to the resource's own URL

steps.title: Create resource with Location header
steps.description: Create POST /users that creates a user and returns 201 with a Location header pointing to the new resource.
hints: After creating the user, set Location header with res.location()
Return 201 status with the created user

steps.title: Related resource links
steps.description: Add GET /users/:id/posts that returns a user's posts. Each post includes links to the user and to itself.
hints: Create a posts array with userId references
Each post response includes links to self and the author user
The user response should also link to their posts

steps.title: Action links in responses
steps.description: Add PUT /posts/:id and DELETE /posts/:id. Include update and delete action links in post responses.
hints: Post responses should include links with rel 'update' and 'delete'
Implement PUT and DELETE handlers for posts
Return the post with its action links on GET and PUT
